steps.content: [Sun Crow Apostle - Ten Scorching Suns] Memory Filter
Everywhere you look, the land is barren and bleached. Figures stand alone or in pairs on the split, desiccated ground, with nothing but sparse, withered grass pushing through the cracks beside them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Harbinger rose, seen in east sky... All lives perished, with ten suns high...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...The real Sun Crow came fiercely and suddenly. There were no preordained omens from the myths, no poisonous trees, no floods or Wraith Spirits, only countless suns in the sky scorching the earth and terrorizing all living things.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...When I was a child, the great drought brought by the Sun Crow dried up the fields, and its little monsters hurt people everywhere... I still remember how Grandma's house was set ablaze. It was terrifying...

steps.speaker: Sealer
steps.content: The calamity has escalated. Several allied states in Eastia have been victimized by the ten suns as well and had to abandon their cities due to the extreme heat. Something major seemed to have happened in DisCity too, cutting off trade completely. We can't import Hypercubes anymore, and our reserves are...
[End of Flashback]
The dark cyan void of chaos unfurls before you once more, devouring every color your memory holds. In the distance, the twisted monstrosity continues to swell.
Lichen wavers, and her knees slam into the ground. She throws out her hands to break the fall, sharp debris slicing her palms, but no sound escapes her.
To see so many calamities yet to unfold, all in a single instant, is more than any soul can endure. Yours included.
You drag in a deep breath and fight to steady your shaking voice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What you just saw... that's what happens a hundred years from now. In your homeland. And in DisCity, where I come from.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That thing you created... it's a monster, just like the Sun Crow. In the future, we call them the <color=#fb9259>Apostles of Ashes</color>.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They're born from the collective consciousness of humanity. The very "wishes" you've been gathering together. And all they do is consume everything in their path. No mind. No control. Completely impossible to use.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Again and again, they're the ones who bring the calamities. Your homeland was almost destroyed because of them. And even...
She keeps her head down and says nothing. Pushing her further would be dangerous now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But look. The monster didn't destroy Eastia completely. Someone managed to hold it back. Your homeland is still there. It's just that—

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>—!
The monster behind you stirs and begins to rise. Power surges up from beneath your feet, and sheer, primal terror grips your chest.
Perhaps because it has just been born, it lacks the overwhelming power of the Apostles of Ashes you have faced before. But even so, it is more than capable of crushing you both.

...No matter what, Lichen has to be taken out of the Void of Yin first. If she can be brought back to her senses and the balance between the Realm of Yang and the Void of Yin restored, the monster might remain trapped here. There's still a chance to escape Maria City.
You lift your hands to her face, and your fingertips meet the slick, sticky warmth of blood.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's still time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You made me a promise, remember? You said you'd come back to me. I can still believe that, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're getting out of here. Together.
Each word grates past your throat, raw and parched. You can't tell anymore whether you're trying to persuade her, or yourself.
Slowly, she lifts her hand and closes it around your wrist with a gentle hold. At last, you feel a flicker of warmth.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Mm. I saw it all.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Monsters beyond imagining. Disasters with no end in sight. People crying out with everything they have, and still no answer from the gods... A hundred years, and nothing's changed.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: A hundred years, and it's already pushed the Eastern Continent back to savagery. Neighbor eating neighbor just to survive.
She sees it now, right? The path she clung to, creating a god to redeem the world, was only ever a mistake.
Then, she lets out a soft laugh.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: But I saw something else, too. No matter how many times those disasters descend upon us, there's nothing to be afraid of.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Because people have faced them again and again—and defeated them, again and again.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Isn't that what you showed me?
She pushes herself upright and lifts her gaze again to the Apostle looming above.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: You said it yourself. It's the same as the monster you showed me, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Then you were right. It has to be stopped, to be taken down...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And that's the last good thing it'll ever do.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I'm going to show the world that there really is a way to <color=#fb9259>vanquish evil</color>. And human hands are all it takes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Vanquish... evil...

steps.speaker: Shin?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>The origin of all, and the secrets of all...

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: The Perishing Star falls, calamities descend... Our <color=#fb9259>ancestors</color> had long foretold the era of great disasters and recorded the true method to <color=#fb9259>subdue demons</color> in legends.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...It's a Sinner, one <color=#fb9259>fused</color> with the Apostle of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Years before the Nightfall, my shifu had already divined the <color=#fb9259>Perishing Star</color>'s arrival.

steps.speaker: Woman's Voice
steps.content: Just as I foresaw, the <color=#fb9259>baleful star</color> has fallen, erasing all in its wake and bringing ruin without end. You have witnessed it, all of it...

steps.speaker: Woman's Voice
steps.content: But do not lose your way... Come. Come to Maria City. Here, you shall find the path to <color=#fb9259>vanquishing evil</color>...

steps.speaker: Woman's Voice
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>You</color> will surely uncover it, and pass it down through the ages, shield those who are yet to come...
If the prophecy holds true, if the one who foretold the Perishing Star's fall was indeed Lichen's shifu...
Then who was it that first uncovered the path of the <color=#fb9259>seers</color>?
She has made a disaster she can't exploit, so she turns to opposing it, subduing it, and finally... merging with it. Does she need so badly to prove that mortals could stand against calamity?!
Everything you went through, was it prophecy fulfilled or myth being written?
Then should you never have stopped her?
The thought that flashes through your mind in that moment chills you to the core. Who is <color=#dg1f1f>tempting</color> you now? Who is <color=#dg1f1f>manipulating</color> you?
You fight to cast the idea aside, but your sight blurs further. Past and future unfold simultaneously before your eyes:
Blaze, blizzard, deluge, thunderclap, houses crumbling, crowds crying, pitiful pleas swallowed into oblivion. Blurred figures press toward the heart of the chaos, like one person, like many, like...
[Lichen's white silhouette]
Within the roiling chaos, Lichen's silhouette sharpens by degrees. For a dizzying instant, she looks just as she did when you first laid eyes on her.
[24 Transitions back to the original background + Lichen's corrupted no-mask character art]
You grab her sleeve and hold tight.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A hundred years from now, people gave everything they had, and no one ever really controlled an Apostle of Ashes. You saw it! So how could you possibly—

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: That was the path they had to walk, in their time.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And now, this is my path to walk.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This was never your responsibility!
You look up. What did you think you would see? The eyes of a zealot, wild and unhinged?
Instead, her stare is perfectly calm, bright and lucid. Maybe it has always been this way.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: "Responsibility"? I never had anything like that.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Seeking the Dao and all that, let's be honest, I was never really a Daoist. Raising the dead? That was always a lie.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: But there's one thing I never lied to you about.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Fortune and misfortune, two sides of the same coin. The calamities brought ruin, but they also gave the Tianyi Sect its power. People burn incense for you, and you'd better earn it. I'm not one of those high and mighty "gods." That much conscience, at least, I still have.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I don't want the world, or you, to spend your lives afraid of losing anything more.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: If you don't believe me, that's fine.
Her eyes move past your shoulder, and she offers a slight, quiet nod to someone behind you.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: You saw it too, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: That people can stand against the calamities with their own two hands. It was never just some delusion of mine.
Then she lowers her head once more, looking into your eyes.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Thank you.
She brushes your hand aside effortlessly and turns her back to you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't—
Two arms lock around your waist and wrench you backward.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Chengxiao?!
Chengxiao clamps his arms around you, his shredded clothes whipping up and momentarily veiling your eyes.
Has it finally reached him too? Is he so desperate to drag you away, back onto the "right" path? Instinct screams at you to fight free, and then...
You notice his gaze. It is locked forward, unblinking, fixed on that single point. He speaks only these words to you:

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Go.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Don't look back.
You turn your head anyway. Just like every hopeless, stubborn fool of a human would.
[Small CG]
The Apostle of Ashes rends a gash in the void above. And so, in this purgatory that transcends life, death, and time itself, a heaven and an earth are born.
She walks between them, step by step, into the black, churning tide of rubble and severed limbs.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Apostle of Ashes... Mania... Is that what you call them in your time?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: They're a mouthful. Sounds exactly like something the little curly-haired one would come up with. I can barely make sense of them.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Doesn't matter. Anything that won't let people live, I'll cut it down.
All around her, the wishes of the living and the dead resound in endless refrain: grant us peace, bring us together, give us shelter, let us rest.

She's heard it all before. She never believed the creature before her could understand anyway. That's the nature of gods, isn't it? They are forever beyond the reach of those mud-soaked hands stretching toward the sky.
What you finally grasp, in the end, is only those next to you.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: A hundred years isn't enough? Then give it another hundred. The universe is vast, time is long. That day will come.
Whatever comes, steel or flood, she will meet it in kind. If a god cannot be made, she'll simply try another road. Until the Dao she seeks is found, this body will not yield.
She pulls her feet free and advances again, allowing the grasping hands to flay her skin piece by piece into the mud.
Until at last, she lifts her gaze.
[Big CG]
The rift above splits wider, unveiling the sky behind it. Light spills through and illuminates the face of the being looking down upon her: gentle, merciful, the face of her shifu.

It was like the first clear day after a deluge brought by the Perishing Star, when the first beam of sky light split the dark clouds and struck the dry, spotless crown of the Celestial Master's statue. Months of relentless rain had never once dampened that stone.
Her shifu held her hand and guided her up the mountain to witness the miracle. Young Li Xianling only stared blankly at the statue. Its shadow swallowed her.
A god that never weeps, and a shifu like this: was there any difference at all?

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>...You did it... You have done so well...

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>...Just as I knew you would. You were always the bravest of them all...

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>...I have heard your wish... Everything you have ever wanted is right here...

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: ...As long as you believe it... As long as... you believe it...
A fierce wind tears through, lifting the veil of copper coins. But a god has no form. In her eyes now, there is only the surging tide of humanity and the slow turn of ages.
The fate that person brings a hundred years from now, she only caught the briefest glimpse of it, not nearly enough to grasp its meaning.
Across that barren waste, fire sweeps the plains and frost cloaks the mountains, yet silhouettes rise into the sky one after another, gripping torches that are also swords, all aimed at the heavens.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>What if you actually die this time?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>What if all your resolve means nothing?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>I fear this so-called means to vanquish evil... may prove to be yet another trap laid by the Perishing Star itself.</color>

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>...Are you really resolved on this?
Truth be told, Li Xianling still doesn't have the answers.
One thing, however, is clear.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Well, that's a pity...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I have never believed in gods.
The bell chimes one final time, piercing through the clamor and hurling a challenge at the divine, one that will resonate across a century.

And then, before your eyes, like every arrogant fool who has dared to face a god,

her body is pierced clean through by the god's merciful hands.
<color=#dg1f1f><size=40>And swallowed whole.
